items.raw_excerpt: A 28-year-old man with a rare pulmonary arteriovenous malformation (PAVM) and a cerebral abscess has been successfully treated through a minimally invasive endovascular procedure at HCG Suchirayu Hospital in Hubballi.
items.summary_en: A 28-year-old man in Hubballi, India, was successfully treated for a rare lung blood vessel defect and a brain abscess. Doctors at HCG Suchirayu Hospital used a minimally invasive endovascular procedure to fix the condition. The patient recovered well after the treatment.
items.summary_ko: 인도 하발리에 사는 28세 남성이 희귀한 폐 동정맥 기형과 뇌 농양을 앓고 있었다. HCG 스시라유 병원 의료진은 최소 친습적 혈관 내 시술로 환자를 성공적으로 치료했다. 환자는 시술 후 건강하게 회복되었다.
items.title_en: Rare lung vessel condition treated with minimally invasive surgery in Hubballi

items.title_original: Rare pulmonary vascular malformation treated through minimally invasive procedure

items.summary_en: Gabriel Moya and Emmanuel Olate turned their love of technology into robotics classes for children in Malargüe. In a city where big tech opportunities often feel far away, they are showing that innovation can start locally.

The new Madring circuit runs across the street from Real's Valdebebas training

items.summary_en: Universidad de Chile coach Fernando Gago praised Manuel Pellegrini's distinguished European football career. Gago highlighted Pellegrini's international reputation and prestige among coaches worldwide. The two are connected as Pellegrini once managed Gago at Real Madrid.

items.raw_excerpt: Bengaluru techie launches ReuniteIndia.com to help families locate missing loved ones from the Nepal floods using verified information.
items.summary_en: A techie in Bengaluru built a free website called ReuniteIndia.com. Families use it to find loved ones who went missing in the Nepal floods. The site only shares verified information.

items.raw_excerpt: Summer in the Algarve definitely doesn't end with August.
items.summary_en: Summer weather is holding on in Portugal's Algarve region well into September. September 3rd was the fourth hottest September day recorded in mainland Portugal since 1941, with temperatures reaching 27.6°C. Beaches are quieter but warm sunny days continue, with temperatures expected near 30°C this weekend.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 남부 알가르베 지역의 여름 날씨가 9월에도 이어지고 있다. 9월 3일은 1941년 이후 포르투갈 본토에서 네 번째로 더운 9월로 기록됐으며, 전국 평균 기온이 27.6도를 기록했다. 해변은 한산해졌지만 따뜻한 햇살은 계속되고 이번 주말에는 30도 근처까지 오를 전망이다.
items.title_en: Summer is still going strong in the Algarve
items.title_original: Summer is still going strong in the Algarve

items.raw_excerpt: Playing on bouncy castles has been linked to the largest ever recorded outbreak of a common superbug in Ireland last year.
items.summary_en: Playing on bouncy castles was linked to the largest MRSA outbreak ever recorded in Ireland. The superbug spread among children who used the inflatables last year.

items.title_en: Bouncy castles linked to Ireland's biggest MRSA outbreak

items.summary_en: From September 18 to 20, the Komen initiative brings doctors to Giardini Margherita in Bologna for cancer prevention. Citizens can meet specialists for free screenings and consultations. The event includes non-competitive races and walks.
